newsitem.title: USA: Caterpillar to build England plant.
newsitem.headline: Caterpillar to build England plant.

text.p: Caterpillar Inc. said Wednesday it will build a new plant in England that will make steel track shoes for earthmoving equipment it builds in Europe.
A spokeswoman declined to say what the company will spend on the plant.
The 46,500-square-foot facility in Skinningrove -- 20 miles south of Middlesbrough -- will initially employ about 35 people, the company said. It is scheduled to be in operation late next year.
Caterpillar has five other manufacturing and distribution facilties in England.
